verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no explicit AI-training opt-out or no-training policy, even though Hoppscotch ships AI features (renaming requests, generating payloads and scripts). The only route is indirect: self-hosting the MIT-licensed Community or Enterprise Edition on your own infrastructure with 'full data ownership', which keeps data away from the vendor. Missing for 10: an explicit policy or setting stating user data is not used for model training, clarity on what data the AI features send to third-party LLM providers, and an opt-out control for the AI features.
